          def replace_once(text: str, old: str, new: str, label: str) -> str:
              count = text.count(old)
              if count != 1:
                  raise SystemExit(f"{label}: expected one match, found {count}")
              return text.replace(old, new, 1)

          def regex_once(text: str, pattern: str, replacement: str, label: str) -> str:
              updated, count = re.subn(pattern, replacement, text, count=1, flags=re.S)
              if count != 1:
                  raise SystemExit(f"{label}: expected one regex match, found {count}")
              return updated

              "ui imports",

          text = replace_once(
              text,
              '''struct PendingUiTask {
    kind: UiTaskKind,
    receiver: Receiver<Result<UiTaskOutput, String>>,
}
''',
              '''const UI_SHUTDOWN_GRACE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(120);

struct PendingUiTask {
    kind: UiTaskKind,
    receiver: Receiver<Result<UiTaskOutput, String>>,
    handle: Option<JoinHandle<()>>,
    cancellation: Arc<AtomicBool>,
}

impl PendingUiTask {
    fn request_cancel_before_admission(&self) {
        self.cancellation.store(true, Ordering::Release);
    }

    fn join_worker(&mut self) -> Result<(), String> {
        let Some(handle) = self.handle.take() else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        handle
            .join()
            .map_err(|_| "native worker panicked before reaching a recoverable boundary".to_owned())
    }

    fn drain_for_shutdown(&mut self, timeout: Duration) -> Result<(), String> {
        match self.receiver.recv_timeout(timeout) {
            Ok(_) | Err(RecvTimeoutError::Disconnected) => self.join_worker(),
            Err(RecvTimeoutError::Timeout) => Err(format!(
                "native worker did not reach a recoverable boundary within {timeout:?}"
            )),
        }
    }
}

fn task_cancelled(cancellation: &AtomicBool) -> Result<(), ShellError> {
    if cancellation.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
        Err(ShellError::State(
            "native task cancelled before admission".to_owned(),
        ))
    } else {
        Ok(())
    }
}
''',
              "pending task supervisor",
          )
          text = replace_once(
              text,
              '''fn spawn_ui_task<F>(kind: UiTaskKind, task: F) -> std::io::Result<PendingUiTask>
where
    F: FnOnce() -> Result<UiTaskOutput, ShellError> + Send + 'static,
{
    let (sender, receiver) = mpsc::channel();
    let handle = std::thread::Builder::new()
        .name(kind.thread_name().to_owned())
        .spawn(move || {
            let outcome = task().map_err(|error| error.to_string());
            let _ = sender.send(outcome);
        })?;
    drop(handle);
    Ok(PendingUiTask { kind, receiver })
}
''',
              '''fn spawn_ui_task<F>(kind: UiTaskKind, task: F) -> std::io::Result<PendingUiTask>
where
    F: FnOnce(&AtomicBool) -> Result<UiTaskOutput, ShellError> + Send + 'static,
{
    let (sender, receiver) = mpsc::channel();
    let cancellation = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
    let worker_cancellation = Arc::clone(&cancellation);
    let handle = std::thread::Builder::new()
        .name(kind.thread_name().to_owned())
        .spawn(move || {
            let outcome = task(worker_cancellation.as_ref()).map_err(|error| error.to_string());
            let _ = sender.send(outcome);
        })?;
    Ok(PendingUiTask {
        kind,
        receiver,
        handle: Some(handle),
        cancellation,
    })
}
''',
              "spawn supervised task",

          text = replace_once(
              text,
              '''    fn on_exit(&mut self, _gl: Option<&eframe::glow::Context>) {
        if let Ok(mut runtime) = self.runtime.try_lock() {
            let _ = runtime.close();
            self.connected = false;
        }
    }
''',
              '''    fn on_exit(&mut self, _gl: Option<&eframe::glow::Context>) {
        let mut shutdown_error = None;
        if let Some(mut task) = self.pending_task.take() {
            // Cancellation is intentionally limited to the pre-admission fence.
            // Once an external effect may have entered the OS adapter, shutdown
            // drains to a durable boundary rather than pretending it can abort it.
            task.request_cancel_before_admission();
            if let Err(error) = task.drain_for_shutdown(UI_SHUTDOWN_GRACE) {
                shutdown_error = Some(error);
            }
        }
        if shutdown_error.is_none() {
            match self.runtime.lock() {
                Ok(mut runtime) => {
                    if let Err(error) = runtime.close() {
                        shutdown_error = Some(error.to_string());
                    } else {
                        self.connected = false;
                    }
                }
                Err(_) => {
                    shutdown_error = Some("native runtime worker lock is poisoned".to_owned());
                }
            }
        }
        match shutdown_error {
            Some(error) => {
                eprintln!("hepta-native shutdown failed: {error}");
                self.activate_update_on_exit.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);
            }
            None => self.activate_update_on_exit.store(
                self.update_activation_requested,
                Ordering::SeqCst,
            ),
        }
    }
''',

    #[test]
    fn locale_selection_covers_chinese_and_safe_english_fallback() {
''',

            outcome.unwrap_err(),
            "native-shell state violation: worker-finished"

        pending.join_worker().unwrap();
    }

    #[test]
    fn shutdown_drain_joins_a_completed_worker() {
        let mut pending = spawn_ui_task(UiTaskKind::Refresh, |_cancellation| {
            Err::<UiTaskOutput, ShellError>(ShellError::State("done".to_owned()))
        })
        .unwrap();
        pending
            .drain_for_shutdown(Duration::from_secs(2))
            .unwrap();
        assert!(pending.handle.is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn shutdown_drain_is_bounded_and_can_finish_after_timeout() {
        let (release, wait) = mpsc::channel();
        let mut pending = spawn_ui_task(UiTaskKind::Refresh, move |_cancellation| {
            wait.recv()
                .map_err(|error| ShellError::State(error.to_string()))?;
            Err::<UiTaskOutput, ShellError>(ShellError::State("done".to_owned()))
        })
        .unwrap();
        let error = pending
            .drain_for_shutdown(Duration::from_millis(10))
            .unwrap_err();
        assert!(error.contains("recoverable boundary"));
        release.send(()).unwrap();
        pending
            .drain_for_shutdown(Duration::from_secs(2))
            .unwrap();
        assert!(pending.handle.is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn locale_selection_covers_chinese_and_safe_english_fallback() {
''',
              "shutdown supervisor tests",

          release_script = r'''#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Audit ui.native release gates without manufacturing external evidence."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PATH = ROOT / "docs/modules/ui.native/RELEASE_GATES.json"
EXPECTED = {
    "six_subject_exact_and_merge_qualification",
    "signed_linux_installer",
    "signed_windows_installer_identity",
    "signed_macos_installer_and_notarization",
    "installed_update_crash_cuts_and_rollback",
    "signing_key_custody_rotation_and_revocation",
    "ordinary_user_keyring_and_desktop_session",
    "keyboard_screen_reader_zh_ime_focus_dpi_multimonitor",
    "long_running_installed_product_measurements",
    "independent_release_approval",
}


def fail(message: str) -> None:
    raise SystemExit("FAIL_UI_NATIVE_RELEASE_GATES: " + message)


def load() -> dict:
    data = json.loads(PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if data.get("schema") != "hepta.ui.native.release-gates.v1":
        fail("schema")
    if data.get("canonicalBranch") != "work/ui-native-integration-convergence-20260927":
        fail("canonical branch")
    rows = data.get("gates")
    if not isinstance(rows, list):
        fail("gate rows")
    ids = [row.get("id") for row in rows]
    if len(ids) != len(set(ids)) or set(ids) != EXPECTED:
        fail("gate closure")
    return data


def audit() -> int:
    data = load()
    if data.get("releaseAuthorized") is not False:
        fail("repository candidate must not self-authorize release")
    for row in data["gates"]:
        if row.get("status") not in {"pending_ci", "pending_external_evidence"}:
            fail(f"unadmitted status for {row['id']}")
        if row.get("evidence") is not None:
            fail(f"unverified evidence attached to {row['id']}")
        if type(row.get("externalAuthority")) is not bool:
            fail(f"external authority type for {row['id']}")
    print(json.dumps({
        "status": "PASS_UI_NATIVE_RELEASE_GATE_BOUNDARY",
        "releaseAuthorized": False,
        "pending": len(data["gates"]),
    }, sort_keys=True))
    return 0


def verify_release() -> int:
    data = load()
    if data.get("releaseAuthorized") is not True:
        fail("release authorization is absent")
    for row in data["gates"]:
        if row.get("status") != "qualified" or not isinstance(row.get("evidence"), dict):
            fail(f"gate is not qualified: {row['id']}")
        evidence = row["evidence"]
        if not isinstance(evidence.get("sha256"), str) or len(evidence["sha256"]) != 64:
            fail(f"content-addressed evidence missing: {row['id']}")
        if not isinstance(evidence.get("issuer"), str) or not evidence["issuer"]:
            fail(f"evidence issuer missing: {row['id']}")
    print(json.dumps({"status": "PASS_UI_NATIVE_RELEASE_GATES"}, sort_keys=True))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("command", choices=["audit", "verify-release"])
    args = parser.parse_args()
    raise SystemExit(audit() if args.command == "audit" else verify_release())
'''
          write("scripts/hepta_ui_native_release_gates.py", release_script)

          release_test = r'''import json
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SCRIPT = ROOT / "scripts/hepta_ui_native_release_gates.py"


class UiNativeReleaseGateTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_candidate_audit_keeps_release_false(self):
        result = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, str(SCRIPT), "audit"],
            cwd=ROOT,
            check=True,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
        )
        payload = json.loads(result.stdout)
        self.assertFalse(payload["releaseAuthorized"])
        self.assertEqual(payload["pending"], 10)

    def test_release_verification_rejects_missing_external_evidence(self):
        result = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, str(SCRIPT), "verify-release"],
            cwd=ROOT,
            check=False,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
        )
        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn("release authorization is absent", result.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
'''
          write("scripts/test_hepta_ui_native_release_gates.py", release_test)

          ledger = f'''# ui.native integration convergence — 2026-09-27

## Candidate identity

The only writable integration candidate is `{NEW}`. It descends linearly from
`709aab0b61f2484b7f5c1efadee96fb14fc5cd31`; its deterministic qualification
base remains `a126987b84737dbc2ee2592442a314117bddb4a2`. This ledger grants no
production, signing, acceptance, promotion or release authority.

## Branch disposition

| Branch | Disposition |
| --- | --- |
| `{OLD}` | absorbed parent; superseded as writable candidate |
| `work/ui-native-operational-closure-20260927` | linear ancestor; historical evidence only |
| `work/ui-native-release-hardening-20260927` | linear ancestor; historical evidence only |
| `work/ui-native-full-closure-20260927` | PR base/ancestor; superseded |
| `{VERIFIED}` | historical protocol ledger; superseded |
| `work/ui-native-closure-20260927` | historical staging branch; superseded |
| `work/ui-native-current-source-20260925` | historical source ancestor; superseded |
| `codex/ui-native-production-convergence-20260926` | historical proposal; not a current candidate |
| `tmp/ui-native-full-convergence-staging-20260926` | staging history; not a current candidate |
| `work/ui-native-remediation-20260927` | diverged proposal-only line at `90de4574abc10020c16f54849aa0482140f7d3f5`; its effect-broker patch requires separate application and native verification before absorption |

Branches are retained for auditability. No old branch may be used to claim a
new pass, and no queued, skipped, cancelled or historical result counts for this
candidate.

## Runtime shutdown invariant

The GUI owns one supervised worker. Shutdown requests cooperative cancellation
only before admission. Once an operation may have entered an owner or OS
boundary, shutdown waits for the worker to reach a recoverable boundary, joins
it, and then closes the runtime. Update activation is published to the outer
process only after both drain and close succeed; timeout, panic, poison or close
failure clears activation and emits an explicit diagnostic.

## Deliberately closed and still-open OS boundaries

Mutable path-string open/reveal remains disabled. The existing resource snapshot
is identity evidence, not an OS-bound capability handoff. Notification launchers
without a queryable operation-bound broker remain indeterminate and are never
blindly replayed. The diverged effect-broker proposal is not treated as source
until separately applied and tested.

Retirement-v2 segments preserve complete closed records and replay fencing. The
current open path reconstructs all retired identities in memory; therefore a
million-record installed-product claim remains blocked on a persistent,
rebuildable disk index plus current-candidate scale receipts.

## Qualification and release boundary

The normal workflow must produce six successful subjects: Linux/macOS/Windows ×
exact head/deterministic merge. Each subject runs identity checks, generated
projection checks, strict formatting and Clippy, app/owner tests, release builds,
unsigned packaging and packaged crash profiles. Missing, skipped or cancelled
subjects fail the aggregate.

`RELEASE_GATES.json` separately records signed installers, notarization,
installer identity, installed update/rollback crash cuts, key custody,
ordinary-user keyring/desktop sessions, physical accessibility/IME/focus/DPI/
multi-monitor work, longitudinal measurements and independent approval. These
must be supplied by their real external issuers; repository CI cannot fabricate
them.
'''
          write("docs/modules/ui.native/INTEGRATION-CONVERGENCE-20260927.md", ledger)

              r'Journal v3 supports v2 opening.*?requires an explicit future migration\.\n',
              '''Journal v6 opens v2-v6 only under explicit schema and integrity checks; v4-v6 carry checksums and migration occurs only on a persisted change. The active journal remains bounded at 4096 records and 8 MiB. Closed terminal or observation-closed records are written as complete immutable record objects and then referenced from sorted, content-addressed retirement-v2 segments before the durable checkpoint is published and before the active copy is removed. Missing, corrupt or conflicting segment/archive state fails closed. Legacy inline tombstones retain their 32768-entry compatibility ceiling.

The segment chain is the replay-fencing authority, but the current open path rebuilds its identity and record maps linearly in total retired history. Million-record startup/RSS claims therefore remain a production gate until a rebuildable persistent index and exact installed-product scale receipts exist; deleting history or weakening replay fencing is not an optimization.
''',
              "technical journal v6 semantics",
          )
